verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox documents isolated microVMs that run agent-generated code. It also supports detached commands that return immediately while the work continues. These are one-off execution primitives a developer would call from their own code, not a feature for setting up automations. The pack shows no scheduling, triggers, recurring jobs, or autonomous background automation configuration, so a one-off detached command cannot stand in for a recurring automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
